en: Five Dhāraṇīs for the Extinction of All Sins, Translated by the Tripitaka Master Xuanzang of the Great Tang, by Imperial Decree. 1.
The Dhāraṇī of a Thousand Turns for the Extinction of All Sins. The Dhāraṇī of a Thousand Turns for the Extinction of All Sins.
Namo ratnatrayāya. Namo āryāvalokiteśvarāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahākāruṇikāya. Tadyathā:
jaye jaye jaya vajri jayavajri jayottare.
